# JioHotstar Ads

> > JioHotstar (Disney+ Hotstar) advertising platform offering self-serve campaign planning, brand measurement, and video advertising solutions for India's leading OTT streaming service.

JioHotstar Ads provides comprehensive advertising tools and documentation for brands looking to reach audiences on Disney+ Hotstar, India's premier streaming platform featuring Bollywood content, original series like Special Ops, The Night Manager, and Aarya, plus live sports and entertainment.

## Key Topics

- JioHotstar
- Disney+ Hotstar
- Self-serve advertising
- Campaign planning
- Video advertising
- Brand measurement
- Brand Lift Study
- Targeting options
- OTT platform
- Video streaming
- Original programming
- Bollywood content
- Adaptive streaming
- Mobile apps (Google Play Store, Apple App Store)

- [About Us](https://ads.hotstar.com/about-us/): Overview of JioHotstar OTT platform and Jiostar India Private Limited
